faqs.q: Sec. 18-487. - I.P.M.C. Section 301.4, Code compliance administration service fees.
faqs.a:
Section 301.4. Code compliance administration service fees,
is hereby added to read as follows:
"
301.4. Code compliance administration service fees.
The code official shall charge those code compliance administration service fees
                  as set forth in the land-use fees ordinance. Any such fees charged but not paid may
                  be assessed against the property in accordance with the provisions of this chapter
                  and of
chapter 59
, "Municipal Liens." These service fees are in addition to and separate from any fines
                  or other penalty imposed by the Municipal Court for violation of any provision of
                  this Code."
(Ord. No.
4738
, § 12, 9-14-2020)
